_note: Eight consumables. Product ids are fixed on Apple and their numbers are historical: the amount each one grants is in lib/data/purchases.dart (StoreProducts.grants) and functions/verify-purchase/src/main.js (GRANTS); test/economy_test.dart checks that the three agree. Prices are USD; the script picks the matching App Store price point and equalises it across territories. Display name <= 30, description <= 45. reviewScreenshot is optional (set to a PNG path to upload one).
